All Gibson Acoustic Models

Selling a Gibson acoustic? Compare the model and condition in the Dove, Southern Jumbo, Country Western or L-0 and L-00 value guide. Each guide includes identification help or a link to its authentication page. The Gibson acoustic overview covers the other flat-top families.

For a Gibson flat-top, the Gibson acoustic model directory links photographs and identification guides for the J-45, J-200, Hummingbird, Dove, Southern Jumbo, Country Western, L-0, L-00 and LG family. Choose the model before applying its value range.
Gibson Country Western Authentication

The Dove authentication guide shows its acoustic Tune-o-matic saddle assembly and explains later changes. For adjustable-saddle and body-shape comparisons in the natural-finish SJN family, see the Country Western authentication guide.
If a natural finish raises an SJ-versus-SJN question, compare the label, body shape and finish evidence in the Country Western authentication guide. A refinish alone does not change the model.
Country Western Authentication

The Country Western authentication guide explains the natural-finish SJN family and how to distinguish it from a refinished SJ. Use the separate Country Western value guide for its model and era ranges.

For the maple-bodied model in this comparison, my Dove authentication guide covers its bridge, woods and original features, while the Dove value guide provides its own era ranges. A natural Gibson with Southern Jumbo trim also needs a separate comparison; see the Country Western authentication guide.

Gibson Southern Jumbo Authentication

For the complete guitar behind a wartime Banner, see the Southern Jumbo authentication guide. For earlier small-body guitars with script or stenciled logos, use the L-0 and L-00 identification checklist alongside the body and finish details.

Compare the headstock and tuner photographs in the L-0 and L-00 identification guide. The Southern Jumbo authentication guide also explains wartime tuner variation and the mounting evidence left by replacements.
Southern Jumbo Authentication

For Banner headstocks, wartime wood variations and later construction changes, use the dedicated Southern Jumbo authentication guide. Once the model and condition are established, compare the Southern Jumbo value ranges.

Use the Southern Jumbo value guide for SJ ranges and its authentication guide for Banner, trim and construction checks. The Country Western value guide covers the natural-finish SJN family; those values should not be taken from the J-45 table.
